note: MPERC lists the three State DISCOMs' orders (always one order for all three) in one table: Period | Tariff Order (date, label, view, download) | True Up Order (date, view, download); the links are icons, so a link's title is its column group's header with the row's period.  A true-up shares the row of the year it trues up.  The 2022-27 MYT order sits in the FY-2022-23 row.  Transmission (MPPTCL) orders are complete only in the petition database (a form search), not covered here.
